Callout.Name: Person with a Knife
Callout.Message: Person in the street with a knife, public backing away.
Callout.Advisory: Male on foot, knife in hand, no victims yet.

Script.Line: He is not doing anything. He is just stood there with it.
Everybody has backed up to the shop front. That is the whole crowd.
He said something about his brother. Nobody understood it.

Lines.Approach: Knife in his hand and people are backing away from him. Nobody has been hurt yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
